target: Style (PO_0009074) absent only in the sterile ray florets (context 'ray floret'). The style of the disc florets (bisexual) is present and filiform

target: The ostiole (syconium ostiole FLOPO_0986063) has no externally visible bracts: the ostiolar bracts are hidden, not absent. Make no bract-absent annotation. The yellowish outer face more likely belongs to the fig or its basal bracts

target: Bract (PO_0009055) absent (PATO_0000462), context lateral (FLOPO_0991380), on the fig (syconium FLOPO_0986130). The basal bracts are present and ovate

target: The lower leaf surface has no dots: at most 'leaf lamina (PO_0020039) not punctate (PATO_0001512)' on the abaxial side. Otherwise drop it. The leaf is present

target: Leaf lamina (PO_0020039) lower surface not punctate (negated PATO_0001512), or no annotation. The lamina is present

target: Awn (PO_0025349) absent on the pedicellate spikelets (context 'pedicelled spikelet') or the lower lemma. The upper lemma of the sessile spikelet has an awn. The awn description itself (straight or curved) should keep its own lemma or spikelet context
fix: In Andropogoneae (Bothriochloa, Dichanthium, Andropogon), 'awnless' in a sentence about the pedicelled spikelet or a sterile lemma is about that member only. Carry the spikelet and floret context into both the absence and the awn description.

target: Lower glume (PO_0006002) absent (PATO_0000462). The upper glume is present and pilose

target: Concave or excavated belongs to the inflorescence axis (rachis, PO_0020122) next to the flowers, not to the stem. 'Stemless' (stem PO_0009047 absent, in the sense of acaulescent) is correct

target: No annotation: 'Capsules not seen' means the fruit is unknown, not absent. Also, 'annulus present' belongs to the perianth tube mouth (perianth PO_0009058), not to the fruit

target: Domatium (FLOPO_0986021) absent (PATO_0000462), on the leaf lamina. The lamina is present and broadly elliptic

target: Glume (PO_0009039) awnless: awn (PO_0025349) absent with the glume as context. The lemma awn is present and straight or curved

target: Phyllode leaf (PO_0025335) absent (PATO_0000462). The pitcher leaves are present, with white areolae
